entries.name: AppScreen
entries.purpose: Primary mobile page shell. Owns top/content/bottom slot composition through AppScreenRoot and AppScreenContent.
strain_notes: Routes should not implement page-local fixed top/bottom chrome when AppScreen can own it.

entries.name: AppScreenRoot
entries.purpose: Frame-scoped root and portal context for special screens and composed templates.
strain_notes: Use directly only when a route needs frame portal behavior without the standard AppScreen flow.

entries.name: ContentOutlet
entries.purpose: Scroll content viewport and default horizontal inset owner.
strain_notes: Horizontal padding should not be re-owned by screen routes or reusable rows.

entries.name: ContentList
entries.purpose: Direct content flow owner inside AppScreenContent.
strain_notes: Domain-specific list wrappers should not re-create direct item gap ownership.

entries.name: ContentSection
entries.purpose: Section boundary and inset exception marker inside ContentOutlet.
strain_notes: Any full-bleed section should be explicit through inset=bleed.

entries.name: ContentRail
entries.purpose: Restores readable rails inside bleed/full-width surfaces.
strain_notes: Use instead of route-local margin/padding corrections.

entries.name: BottomSheet
entries.purpose: Composed bottom-sheet API over WDS Modal with frame portal/backdrop/content contracts.
strain_notes: Routes should not create separate absolute backdrops or WDS ModalContainer directly.
